## SUPERSEDED / CLOSED WITHOUT MERGE

This reviewer-specific production re-entry is superseded by CAP's general Agent Session / Delegation direction. It must not merge.

The useful research conclusions were preserved in the PR discussion/body before closure. Reviewer-specific repository-context architecture is no longer the release-critical CAP product path.

### Branch-history hygiene

The branch was force-reset to the last pre-browser-companion commit `8e06920c08b3612feed57a4d98da4a5913de2f77` because the later experimental Chrome manifest introduced a fixed public RSA extension `key`. That key was not a credential, but gitleaks classified the high-entropy literal as a secret candidate and the repository Secret History Scan traverses every reachable branch ref. Keeping the superseded commit chain reachable therefore made unrelated new PRs fail the repository-wide secret scan.

No accepted `main` state was rewritten. No reviewer-specific implementation from this PR is accepted as production authority.
